acceptance: A guard test fails on --with/pip/uv add of PyPI sqlglot (all spellings, continuations, Python arg lists) outside the isolated comparison form.
Guard passes on the repository and runs on the release tree.
description: benchbox/_vendor/__init__.py appends the bundled SQLGlot wheel to benchbox._vendor.__path__, so a PyPI sqlglot added with uv run --with sqlglot==X is never imported by code under test (probe: --with sqlglot==26.0.0 printed 26.0.0 while exercised code used vendored 30.x). The retired tpchavoc-sqlglot-minimum-check gate was green but meaningless.
